title: sarcanthus tenuifolius
intro: Sarcanthus tenuifolius, commonly known as the "Yellow Lady's Slipper Orchid", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sarcanthus tenuifolius include its use in treating coughs, colds, and digestive issues, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
